transcript: At some point in life, you stop asking, why did this happen to me? And start realizing it happened for you. Maybe the pain wasn't punishment, maybe it was preparation. The heartbreak that shattered you, it taught you how to love without losing yourself. The silence that hurt so much, it taught you how to listen to your own soul and all those people who walked away. They were never meant to walk your whole path. We spend years searching for peace in other people, in success, in control. But peace isn't found there. Peace begins when you stop fighting with life, when you stop saying this shouldn't have happened and instead whisper, maybe this is how I grow. The universe never punishes you, it redirects you, it clears away what blocks your path so you can meet the version of yourself that was buried under all the noise, all the pretending, all the pain you thought you'd never survive. So if you're feeling lost right now, remember this, you're not behind, you're being aligned, you're not broken, you're becoming, and one day, you'll look back and understand why everything had to happen exactly the way it did. If you stayed until here, comment yes and tell me where you're from. I love seeing how far these messages travel.
